semiconductor_relevance: High — Panasonic Connect Co., Ltd. specializes in electronic materials that are critical for semiconductor device applications and high-multilayer substrates.
summary: Panasonic Connect Co., Ltd. focuses on providing advanced electronic materials for the semiconductor industry, particularly through its MEGTRON series, which supports high-speed and high-capacity transmission in communication infrastructure. Their materials are designed for high-performance semiconductor packages and test boards, addressing the evolving demands of AI and network technology.
capabilities: High heat-resistant multilayer substrate materials (MEGTRON series)
Low transmission loss materials for electronic circuit boards
Materials for semiconductor test board applications such as probe cards and load boards
